name: Code Generation Workflow
description: Generate code based on requirements, with optional existing codebase context. Analyzes requirements, designs the solution, generates code, and creates tests.

stages.name: Requirements Analysis
stages.description: Analyze and break down the requirements

prompts.label: Analyze Requirements

stages.name: Code Generation
stages.description: Generate the actual code based on the analysis

prompts.label: Generate Code

stages.name: Test Generation
stages.description: Generate comprehensive tests for the generated code

prompts.label: Generate Tests
prompts.text:
Generate comprehensive tests for the code generated in the previous stage. Include:
1. Unit tests for all functions/methods
2. Integration tests for key flows
3. Edge case tests

Use {{test_framework}} as the testing framework.

stages.name: Documentation
stages.description: Generate documentation for the generated code

prompts.label: Generate Documentation
prompts.text:
Generate comprehensive documentation for the code generated above. Include:
1. README with setup instructions
2. API documentation (if applicable)
3. Architecture overview
4. Usage examples

variables.name: git_url
variables.label: Repository URL (Optional)
variables.description: If building on existing code, provide the git repository URL

variables.name: requirements
variables.label: Requirements
variables.description: Detailed description of what you want to generate

variables.name: framework
variables.label: Framework
variables.description: Framework to use (e.g., React, Express, Django, Spring)

variables.name: test_framework
variables.label: Test Framework
variables.description: Testing framework to use (e.g., Jest, Vitest, Pytest)
